title: Placeholder passwords in connection URIs: must be flagged
summary: Connection URIs whose password only resembles a placeholder: filler characters ending in a real-looking character, or a placeholder word embedded in or prefixed to a real-looking value. Covers 3 inputs.
rationale: Templates for connection strings are everywhere in documentation. A placeholder in the password position is an instruction to the reader, not a secret.

expectation.rationale: Issue-specific literal/password range; expectations are the project’s masking policy.
